钱包服务暂时不可用，请重新打开插件。: Wallet service is unavailable. Reopen the extension.
语言设置无法保存，请重试。: Could not save your language. Try again.
锁定失败，请关闭浏览器。: Could not lock the wallet. Close the browser.
复制失败，请手动选择文字。: Copy failed. Select the text manually.
把钱包留在自己手里。: Keep your wallet in your hands.

请保存助记词。忘记密码后，需要助记词恢复钱包。: Save your recovery phrase. You will need it to restore your wallet if you forget the password.
输入密码，继续管理你的 PRL。: Enter your password to manage your PRL.
离开操作 5 分钟后自动锁定；重启浏览器后需重新解锁。: Locks after 5 minutes of inactivity. Unlock again after restarting the browser.
点击刷新获取链上余额: Refresh to fetch your on-chain balance
当前为测试网，测试币不具有主网价值。: You are on testnet. Test coins have no mainnet value.
网络回复丢失时，交易可能已经发出。核对状态或重试同一笔交易。: The transaction may have been sent even if the reply was lost. Check its status or retry the same transaction.
确认前保留原交易，防止重复付款。: Keep the original transaction until confirmed to avoid duplicate payments.
助记词和私钥不会发送给链上查询服务。恢复原生钱包后，点击“检查历史找零”核对旧地: Recovery phrases and private keys are never sent to the chain service. After restoring a native wallet, scan historical change to check funds on old addresses.
当前覆盖收款和找零分支各前 200 个地址；完整历史扫描最多 200 页。: Covers the first 200 addresses on each receiving and change branch; a full history scan is limited to 200 pages.
备份核对未通过，请检查第 3、7、11 个单词。: Backup check failed. Check words 3, 7 and 11.
按顺序保存这 12 个单词。拥有助记词的人可以支配钱包资金。: Save these 12 words in order. Anyone with the recovery phrase can spend the wallet funds.
下一步会核对你的备份。不要只把助记词留在浏览器里。: Next, we will check your backup. Do not keep your recovery phrase only in the browser.
至少 10 个字符，用于加密本机钱包。: At least 10 characters, used to encrypt the wallet on this device.
轮换地址仍属于同一个钱包，余额会合并统计。: Rotated addresses belong to the same wallet. Their balances are combined.
已读取链上建议值，可手动调整。: Network estimate loaded. You can adjust it manually.
当前为默认值，请核对手续费。: Using the default rate. Please review the fee.
预览会重新获取可用输入。仅使用已确认、未被待确认交易占用的资金。: The preview refreshes available inputs. Only confirmed funds that are not reserved for pending transactions can be spent.
广播结果待核对，请查看待确认转账。不要重复创建付款。: Broadcast status is unknown. Check pending transfers. Do not create another payment.
预览在 3 分钟后失效。确认时在本机签名，再发送已签名交易。: The preview expires in 3 minutes. Confirmation signs on this device, then sends the signed transaction.
按顺序离线保存。关闭窗口后不再显示。: Save offline in order. The phrase is hidden when you close this window.
查看助记词前，再次验证解锁密码。: Verify your unlock password to view the recovery phrase.
已重试原交易，请核对链上状态。: Original transaction retried. Check its on-chain status.
只重发此前签好的同一笔交易，金额和收款地址不会改变。: Only the previously signed transaction is sent again. Its amount and recipient do not change.
密码已更新。此密码保护插件中的所有钱包。: Password updated. This password protects all wallets in the extension.
从这台浏览器移除当前钱包: Remove this wallet from this browser
移除只删除本机记录。请先备份助记词，链上资金不会自动转出。: This only deletes local records. Back up your recovery phrase first. On-chain funds are not transferred automatically.
操作已取消，钱包已锁定。: Operation cancelled. The wallet is locked.
最多管理 10 个钱包。: You can manage up to 10 wallets.
这个钱包已经添加。: This wallet has already been added.
钱包或网络已切换，请重新操作。: Wallet or network changed. Try the action again.
此钱包仍有待确认交易，请先核对链上状态。: This wallet has pending transactions. Check their on-chain status first.
交易预览已过期，请重新确认。: Transfer preview expired. Review it again.
可用输入已变化，请重新生成预览。: Available inputs changed. Generate a new preview.
交易费用已变化，请重新确认。: Transaction fees changed. Review them again.
这些输入已有待确认交易。: These inputs are reserved for a pending transaction.
链上交易编号不一致。: On-chain transaction ID does not match.
链上响应过大，请稍后重试。: The chain response is too large. Try again later.
链上服务暂时不可用。: The chain service is temporarily unavailable.
历史超过 200 页，当前版本无法完整恢复历史找零。: History exceeds 200 pages. This version cannot fully recover historical change.
助记词无效，请检查单词和顺序。: Invalid recovery phrase. Check the words and their order.
金额最多保留 8 位小数。: Amounts support up to 8 decimal places.
输入数量过多，请分批转账。: Too many inputs. Split the transfer into smaller batches.
交易输入不属于此钱包，或地址索引超出支持范围。: An input does not belong to this wallet or its address index exceeds the supported range.
手续费率超出范围。: Fee rate is outside the allowed range.
收款地址无效或网络不匹配。: Invalid receiving address or wrong network.
交易预览已变化，请重新确认。: Transfer preview changed. Review it again.
密码错误或钱包文件损坏。: Wrong password or damaged wallet file.
解锁密码至少 10 个字符。: The unlock password must be at least 10 characters.
移除记录不会撤销链上交易。请先核对交易和收款方；再次付款可能造成重复付款。: Discarding this record does not cancel a transaction on the chain. Check the transaction and recipient first; paying again may result in a duplicate payment.
我已核对并了解重复付款风险: I checked and understand the duplicate payment risk
请确认移除记录的风险。: Confirm the risk of discarding this record.
保存常用收款地址，转账时一键选择。: Save your frequent receiving addresses and pick one in a tap when sending.
这个地址已经在地址簿中。: This address is already in the address book.
联系人不存在，请刷新。: Contact not found. Refresh and try again.
喜欢 Pearl Hub？请开发者喝杯咖啡: Enjoying Pearl Hub? Buy the developer a coffee
捐赠会从当前钱包直接转到开发者地址，在本机签名并广播，手续费从余额扣除。: Your donation is sent from the current wallet straight to the developer's address. It's signed on this device and broadcast; the network fee comes out of your balance.
自定义金额最少 1 PRL。: Custom amount must be at least 1 PRL.
当前钱包不能捐赠。: Donations are unavailable for this wallet.
在网页观察这个地址: Watch this address on the web
仅预填地址，请在网页确认保存。: Only prefills the address. Confirm saving on the web.
只同步联系人；助记词、私钥和钱包密码保留在本机。: Only contacts are synced. Recovery phrases, private keys and wallet passwords stay on this device.
已验证地址路径的输入均可签名；历史找零扫描只读取转出记录，支持分页和增量更新。: Inputs with verified address paths can be signed. Change discovery reads outgoing transactions only, with pagination and incremental updates.
没有可归集的已确认找零。: No confirmed change available to consolidate.
旧记录未提供地址路径时，手动扫描最多核对前 10,000 个找零地址。: For old records without address paths, manual recovery checks the first 10,000 change addresses.
已使用手动填写的手续费率。: Using your manually entered fee rate.
通过邮箱账号同步通讯录。云端加密存储，服务器可读；助记词、私钥和密码仅保存在本机: Sync contacts through your email account. Cloud data is encrypted at rest and readable by the server; seed phrases, private keys and passwords stay on this device.
请输入交易 ID：64 位，由 0–9 和 a–f 组成。: Enter a transaction ID: 64 characters, 0–9 and a–f.
没有找到这笔交易。刚发出的交易可能要稍等片刻才能查到。: Transaction not found. One sent moments ago can take a little while to appear.
已重新广播，交易再次发往网络。: Rebroadcast: the transaction went to the network again.
网络中已有这笔交易。: The network already has this transaction.
网络没有回应，无法确定交易是否已发出。可以先查询，或再广播一次：同一笔交易重复广: No answer from the network, so it isn’t known whether the transaction went out. Look it up, or broadcast it again: sending the same transaction twice is safe.
在本机签名，上链后不可撤销: Signed on this device · final once on-chain
本笔手续费明显高于平常，请确认。: This fee is much higher than usual — please double-check.
